$comment: Source registry for tools/source-acquisition/acquire.py.
URLs live here rather than in the script so that correcting one is a
data edit, not a code change, and so that the diff on a correction
shows exactly what moved.
status: CONFIRMED means a person has fetched this URL and checked that
what came back is what the entry says. UNCONFIRMED means it came from a
planning note and has never been tested. Both download; both are
labelled in the console output and in every run manifest. Nothing in
this build has been able to reach these hosts — the session that wrote
this file was on a network that denies them at CONNECT — so every entry
starts UNCONFIRMED and it is the operator who promotes one.
To promote an entry: run --probe, then --fetch, open the file, satisfy
yourself it is the right document, and set status to CONFIRMED with a
note saying when and by whom.
expect: what a good payload looks like. min_bytes and magic are what
catch a portal answering an unknown path with a login page or an error
page — HTTP 200, plausible filename, wrong thing entirely.
auth_env: the environment variable holding a bearer token, where a
source needs one. Never put the token in this file.

Province coverage: North West is fetched and confirmed for all five cycles. The other eight provinces carry rows for 2011, 2016 and 2021 built on the confirmed event ids with the province token inferred - UNCONFIRMED until somebody fetches one. The 2000 and 2006 cycles are single national archives, so they are one row each and already confirmed.
$suppliedDocumentsComment: Documents this build holds that did NOT come through this tool. They
were handed over directly, which is why the hosts being unreachable
did not stop them arriving. They are listed here because 'what
primary sources does this build actually hold' is a question the
acquisition registry should be able to answer, and a fetch registry
of URLs nobody has reached answers it with 'none'.
No URL is recorded for these. The URL each was published at is not
known here and inventing a plausible one is the exact failure this
registry exists to correct. Whoever finds the real published location
should add an ordinary source row and compare the SHA-256.

A supplier who has fetched an endpoint and recorded what came back satisfies this registry's own promotion rule, so those rows read CONFIRMED with the supplier and date named in the note. Each such note also states plainly that THIS build has not fetched it.

suppliedDocuments.note: Annexure A to IEC Circular 1 of 2025: registered voters (2024), councillors determined by the MEC, and ward counts for all 258 municipalities, with the Norm/Min/Max/15% band for the 214 that have wards. Produced from Excel 2025-02-27, last modified 2025-03-10, seven pages. Extracted by tools/annexure/extract-annexure-a.py into src/data/iec/circular-1-2025-annexure-a.json, with every derived column checked against the document's own arithmetic before anything was written. This is the first primary IEC source in the build covering more than one municipality, and it independently confirms NW405's 122,059 voters and 34 wards.

Document ref IC-ECOS-07-NW-MANIFEST-2026. Compiled 2026-09-23 from the IEC's 2000-2021 North West VD-level results files and the MDB's final 2026 ward layer. Six sheets: README, Ward_Counts, Source_Log, Allow_Audit, Code_Changes, Open_Items. It supplied the confirmed download endpoints in this registry, the municipal code discontinuities in src/modules/reference/municipalCodeHistory.ts, and the per-municipality 2026 ward counts now asserted against the proclaimed delimitation in municipalRegister.test.ts. Its own Allow_Audit sheet independently reached the finding this project recorded as register entry 33.1: the earlier "Extraction Protocol Complete" report was false and no files existed.

sources.note: North West Provincial Gazette Extraordinary Vol 268 No. 8929, 18 November 2025 (Provincial Notice 1300 of 2025). This is the notice docs/nw405-seed-data.md was parsed from, and the only source in this registry whose contents this build has actually used. The URL is a reconstruction of where it is published and has not been fetched from here — the filename is the confirmed part, the path is not.

MDB final 2026 ward boundaries, NATIONAL. ArcGIS item c59982d9f42a4b07929f3781883754e5, updated 2026-09-01; published EPSG:3857. The supplier fetched this item and derived a North West subset of 402 ward features - exactly the 402 wards the proclaimed delimitation gives North West across its 18 local municipalities (asserted in municipalRegister.test.ts). One national row rather than nine provincial ones because this is one item: the province subset is a local operation, not a different download. Nationally the layer should carry 4,488 ward features; that figure is this build's, from the delimitation, and has not been checked against the layer. The layer carries no registered-voter figures, so a ward-level deviation check still needs the MDB ward information tables. Supersedes the explore-page URL this row shipped with, which was a human-facing page rather than a download. Endpoint confirmed by the supplier's own retrieval on 2026-09-23, recorded in NW_07_Repository_Manifest.xlsx Source_Log. This build has NOT fetched it.
